newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 70 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 70 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Monday morning a 70-billion-bolivar auction of 177-, 266- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 21.18 percent.

The bank said it would offer 40 billion bolivars worth of 177-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 20.15 percent, 15 billion bolivars of 266-day bills at 20.65 percent and 15 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 21.18 percent.
At its auction last week the central bank sold 3 billion bolivars worth of 177 266 and 358-day bills with yields of 20.15, 21.90 and 22.88 percent respectively.
